description: The ISC Cryptographic Development Kit (CDK) is a software development toolkit providing a comprehensive set of cryptographic primitives for use in any application. It includes RSA, DSA/Diffie-Hellman and elliptic curve algorithms, as well as a wide range of symmetric ciphers and hash functions.
